purpose: Generalization spot-check: 12 prompts deliberately outside the fire/physics/impact training distribution, comparing our 4-step DMD LoRA (gate800) against LightX2V Turbo8 and OpenVDN VDN-H3 (both 8-step).
frame_count_note: VDN outputs probe at 107 frames; gate800/turbo8 outputs probe at 106 frames -- consistent with the same muxer/container-level cosmetic difference already documented for the sglang-vs-diffusers comparison; not a content-duration issue.

summary.overall: gate800 is roughly on par with Turbo8 and slightly ahead of VDN-H3 on this 12-prompt qualitative spot-check. gate800 is not claimed to be globally better than either baseline.
summary.caveat: Qualitative generalization check on 12 clips across three different distillation efforts at different step counts (4 vs 8) -- not a rigorous benchmark.

prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Medium two-shot, static camera, daytime cafe interior. Two friends sit across a small wooden table, one leaning in and gesturing with both hands while talking, the other smiling and nodding, coffee cups between them.
overall_soundscape: Warm conversational chatter, occasional laughter, faint background cafe murmur, the clink of a cup on a saucer.
non_diegetic_music: Soft, upbeat acoustic guitar, low in the mix.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Smooth handheld tracking shot from behind, following a person walking down a busy city sidewalk past storefronts, other pedestrians passing in both directions, daylight.
overall_soundscape: City ambience -- footsteps, distant traffic, overlapping passerby chatter, a car horn in the distance.
non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Static wide shot, sunny park lawn. A medium-sized dog runs across the grass chasing a thrown tennis ball, catches up to it, and bounds back toward the camera with the ball in its mouth, tail wagging.
overall_soundscape: Panting, paws thudding on grass, a distant human voice calling the dog's name, birdsong.
non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Close-up, static camera, overhead-angled, kitchen counter. A pair of hands steadily chops carrots on a wooden cutting board with a kitchen knife, pushing the sliced pieces aside between cuts.
overall_soundscape: Rhythmic chopping on wood, occasional faint kitchen background hum.
non_diegetic_music: Light, relaxed instrumental.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Static medium-wide shot, tree-lined park path, morning light. A jogger in athletic clothing runs along the path from background to foreground, arms pumping naturally, passing out of frame.
overall_soundscape: Steady rhythmic footfalls, light breathing, rustling leaves overhead, distant birdsong.
non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Static wide shot, quiet paved road beside a field, daytime. A cyclist pedals steadily along the road from one side of the frame to the other, wheels spinning, jacket rippling slightly in the wind.
overall_soundscape: Steady whir of bicycle tires on pavement, faint chain clicking, a light breeze.
non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Smooth lateral tracking shot from inside a moving passenger train, camera positioned at a window seat looking out through the glass as a countryside landscape of golden wheat fields, a distant farmhouse, and scattered trees streams by continuously.
overall_soundscape: A steady rhythmic clack of wheels on rails, faint train engine hum, a soft gust of wind at the window seal.
non_diegetic_music: Gentle, wistful acoustic guitar melody.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Static medium shot, cozy living room, soft afternoon light through a window. A person sits curled up on a couch reading a paperback book, occasionally turning a page and shifting their posture slightly.
overall_soundscape: Near silence, a faint page-turn rustle, quiet room tone, a distant ticking clock.
non_diegetic_music: Sparse, mellow piano.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Slow static-mounted panning shot, golden-hour light, sweeping across a mountain valley with a winding river below, forested slopes, and distant snow-capped peaks.
overall_soundscape: Light wind, a faint distant bird call, near silence otherwise.
non_diegetic_music: Low, expansive ambient orchestral swell.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Close-up, static camera, kitchen counter. A hand tilts a coffee pot and pours a steady stream of coffee into a ceramic mug, steam rising as the mug fills near to the brim.
overall_soundscape: A steady trickling pour, a soft ceramic clink as the pot is set back down.
non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Medium shot, static camera, home office. A person sits at a desk typing on a laptop keyboard, occasionally glancing at the screen and pausing to think before continuing to type.
overall_soundscape: Steady keyboard clacking, a faint mouse click, quiet room ambience.
non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Static medium shot, outdoor farmers market stall, daytime. A customer picks up a piece of fruit from a wooden crate, turns it over inspecting it, then sets it into a hand basket while the vendor behind the stall watches and smiles.
overall_soundscape: Ambient market chatter, distant overlapping voices, a faint clink of produce being handled.
non_diegetic_music: None.
